title: Why Rival Armies Raced Horses on the Same Island
script: Did you know British and American troops once held horse races on an island both countries claimed? On San Juan Island, the two sides had nearly come to blows in eighteen fifty-nine. Then they pitched camps at opposite ends of the island and waited for someone to settle the border. They waited twelve years. Long enough for the men to visit each other's camps and race horses together. So who finally drew the line between Britain and America? In eighteen seventy-two, the German emperor settled it. The islands went to the United States.
